note: The bilingual user-facing text for the optional community plugin prompts. It lives here, in the Node layer, because the installer's PowerShell files are ASCII-only by contract: Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads a BOM-less .ps1 as ANSI, so a Chinese character written into one of them corrupts the prompt or the parse. The Node command line runs with UTF-8 output, so the user still reads their own language -- which is what the requirement asked for.

prompt.heading: 可选社区插件 / Optional community plugins
prompt.intro:
DS-Hns 可以再装两个社区插件；它们都是可选的，不装也能正常使用。
DS-Hns can install two more community plugins. Both are optional; the product works without them.
prompt.default:
默认是 2（跳过）。除非你明确选择，否则不会安装任何可选插件。
The default is 2 (Skip). Nothing optional is installed unless you choose it.
prompt.choose: 为 {label} 选择 1 或 2 [2] / Choose 1 or 2 for {label} [2]
prompt.invalid: 请输入 1 或 2。 / Please answer 1 or 2.

dsh-wallpaper-engine.question: 是否安装 Wallpaper Engine（壁纸引擎）？ / Install Wallpaper Engine?
